catalog.description: Holds one confirmed markdown body as a chip. Nothing is written yet.

catalog.name: propose_house_from_current
catalog.description: Applies exact find-and-replace pairs onto the current text and holds the result as a chip.

find.description: Exact substring in current house (must appear exactly once)

catalog.name: commit_on_go
catalog.description: Spoken GO write. kind is house, register, or drivers. A KEEP line is not this call.

utterance.description: User line verbatim (GO / looks good / CONFIRM / ACCEPT REGISTER)

catalog.name: list_house_proposals
catalog.description: Inventory of house chips.

catalog.name: propose_risk_status
catalog.description: Queues an INTACT, WATCH, or FIRED label onto an existing row.

risk_name.description: e.g. R3 — Customer concentration… or R3

catalog.name: propose_add_risk
catalog.description: Propose NEW risk on register. Research first. File stays unchanged until spoken GO.

catalog.name: list_risk_proposals
catalog.description: Roster of register changes.

catalog.name: get_risk_sor
catalog.description: Reads one register section, including its tripwire table.

catalog.name: list_house_driver_candidates
catalog.description: Asks for engines the user names. Does not dump headings.

catalog.name: propose_keep_driver
catalog.description: Stores a KEEP chip for one named engine, quoting the confirmed house. Later GO writes 09.

house_cite.description: Quote from the live CONFIRMED house. The engine must already be in that house.

title.description: Engine name. Not a house heading.

watching.description: What the user wants watched on this engine

why.description: One paragraph: why this side of the business is the bull case

catalog.name: propose_driver_log
catalog.description: Appends one dated note onto an engine that is already kept.

figures.description: Replace the figures strip when a print updates the numbers

catalog.name: propose_skip_driver
catalog.description: Records a quote the user will not follow. Does not open an engine.

catalog.name: get_driver_sor
catalog.description: Reads kept engine lines from 09. Empty when that file is absent.

catalog.name: list_driver_proposals
catalog.description: Queued KEEP and SKIP rows.

catalog.name: propose_risk_tripwires
catalog.description: Replaces the tripwire table on an existing row after the user agrees.

tripwires.description: Final list after user cull — only monitors Anthony wants

catalog.name: agent_accept_status
catalog.description: Reports whether this install allows an agent to save on its own.

catalog.description: Agent flag updating register headings. Not commit_on_go.
